p: Behold, our Sages of blessed memory
“the fifteenth” from the festival of matzos
that the holiness of the meal of the festival of Sukkos
הוּא אֶחָד עִם מִצְוַת אֲכִילַת מַצָּה.
is one with the mitzvah of eating matzah.
is a matter of subduing the Other Side.
that no leaven be seen in what one eats,
and it is only one mitzvah
for all the days of the festival.
But the holiness of the festival of Sukkos
is to transform darkness into light,
that is, to bring the opposite into holiness,
for the mitzvah of eating in the sukkah
Therefore on each day of the festival
הוּא אוּשְׁפִּיזָא אַחַת (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קג, ב),
and also seventy bulls are offered
that is, to refine the evil
each of which is comprised of ten,
and to bring them into holiness.
which is the seventh of the festival,
all seven middos are included in holiness.
It may be said that to this
“In six troubles He will save you,
and in seven no evil will touch you”:
עַל שְׁלִיטוּת שִׁשָּׁה מַלְכֻיּוֹת עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל
referring to the dominion of six kingdoms over Israel,
in order to refine from them
the aspect of the opposite within the middos
מִצְרַיִם יָרַד עַמִּי בָרִאשׁוֹנָה לָגוּר שָׁם
“My people went down at first to Mitzrayim to sojourn there,
and Ashur oppressed them for nothing.”
serve to refine the six middos
from the opposite that is found in each nation,
and to bring it into holiness.
מִצְרַיִם הוּא נֶגֶד בְּחִינַת חֶסֶד שֶׁבִּקְדוּשָּׁה,
Mitzrayim corresponds to the aspect of chessed in holiness,
וְהוּא מִדַּת אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם,
which is the attribute of Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him;
“that your offspring will be strangers,” etc.,
וְגַם אֶת הַגּוֹי אֲשֶׁר יַעֲבוֹדוּ דָּן אָנֹכִי
“and also the nation whom they will serve I will judge,
and afterward they will go out with great wealth”
to refine the chessed of holiness
which is called “the nakedness of the land,”
Ashur is the aspect of gevurah,
“You say — it is but empty words —
עֵצָה וּגְבוּרָה לַמִּלְחָמָה (מְלָכִים ב יח, כ),
that you have counsel and might for war” (Melachim II 18:20),
meaning that he has might for war;
“By the strength of my hand I have done it” (Yeshayahu 10:13).
The exile of Bavel corresponds to the opposite
which is the aspect of haughtiness and self-exaltation,
“I will ascend above the heights of the clouds,
I will be like the Most High” (Yeshayahu 14:14).
of Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (מְגִלָּה יג, ב)
as our Sages of blessed memory said (Megillah 13b):
once the lot fell for him
on the month of Adar he rejoiced,
for it is the month in which
Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him, died,
and he imagined that through this he would have
And although this was the counsel of Haman,
עִם כָּל זֶה אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ הִסְכִּים עִמּוֹ,
and he is the aspect of Madai.
Yavan is the aspect of Greek wisdom,
which opposes the Torah she'b'al peh
of the days of the Men of the Great Assembly,
and that is the aspect of Aharon HaKohen,
וְתוֹרַת אֱמֶת הָיְתָה בְּפִיהוּ (מַלְאָכִי ב, ו).
and “the Torah of truth was in his mouth” (Malachi 2:6).
The exile of Edom corresponds to
the aspect of yesod in holiness,
which binds all the middos together;
and so too is the aspect of Edom and Yishmael,
who bind together the totality of the seventy nations,
that thirty-five princes are on the right
And so our exile is under both of them,
כִּי אֱדוֹם הֶחֱרִיב אֶת בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ,
for Edom destroyed the Beis HaMikdash,
וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל יֵשׁ לוֹ שְׁלִיטָה בְּאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל,
and Yishmael has dominion in Eretz Yisrael,
כִּדְאִיתָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב לב, א),
as is brought in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 32a);
and the dominion of these two faiths
וְעַל זֶה מְרַמֵּז הַפָּסוּק (יְשַׁעְיָה נב, א)
This is what the verse alludes to (Yeshayahu 52:1),
כִּי לֹא יוֹסִיף יָבֹא בָךְ עוֹד
“For there shall no longer come into you
who does not hold to circumcision,
that there is holiness in it.
he defiles his covenant, as is known.
In the six days of the festival
of Dovid HaMelech, peace be upon him,
who receives from all the middos
and has nothing of his own,
שֶׁאֵין בּוֹ לֹא טַעַם וְלֹא רֵיחַ,
that has neither taste nor fragrance,
“I was brought low, and He will save me”:
אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁדַּלָּה אֲנִי בְּמִצְוֹת,
“Even though I am poor in mitzvos,
I am Yours, and it is fitting to save me”
we act to subdue the aspect of Gog and Magog,
and is the totality of the seventy nations,
who stand against the aspect of “Anochi,”
וְרָגְשׁוּ יַחַד עַל ה׳ וְעַל מְשִׁיחוֹ.
and rage together against Hashem and against His anointed.
“and in seven no evil will touch you”:
for the wars of Gog and Magog
לֹא יִהְיֶה לוֹ שׁוּם שְׁלִיטָה עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל,
will have no dominion at all over Israel,
will immediately subdue him to holiness.
Now it is brought in the Gemara (Sukkah 45a):
בְּכָל יוֹם מַקִּיפִין אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ פַּעַם אַחַת
“Each day they would circle the altar once,
and on that day seven times”;
with the lulav and the four species,
for our Sages of blessed memory said (ibid.):
“Whoever takes a lulav in its binding
and a hadas with its thick leaves,
as though he built an altar,” etc.,
“Bind the festival offering with thick cords,” etc.
It is one and the same matter
and on the seventh day, on Shabbos,
Through this they subdued the totality
of the seven nations of Eretz Yisrael,
of the seven middos of holiness, as is known,
Likewise on the seventh day of the festival
which are the aspect of the totality of the seventy.
אָרוּר אֲשֶׁר יִבְנֶה אֶת יְרִיחוֹ (יְהוֹשֻׁעַ ו, כו),
with any of the towns of Eretz Yisrael.
It may be said regarding this
that it is because in Yericho
there was the dominion of the king of Bavel,
as our Sages of blessed memory said
עַל פָּסוּק (יְהוֹשֻׁעַ ז, כא) אַדֶּרֶת שִׁנְעָר —
on the verse (Yehoshua 7:21) “a mantle of Shinar”:
for he had a palace in Yericho,
and he had an officer in Yericho
from Yericho, the city of palms.
כְּאָמְרָם זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (פְּסָחִים פז, ב – פח, א)
as our Sages of blessed memory said (Pesachim 87b–88a):
“For this reason they were exiled to Bavel,
so that they would eat dates,” etc.
It may be said that Yehoshua
אִם לֹא יַכְנִיעוּ מִקּוֹדֶם אֶת יְרִיחוֹ,
which is the dominion of the king of Bavel,
שֶׁהָיָה רֹאשׁ הַמַּחֲרִיב אֶת בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ,
who was the chief destroyer of the Beis HaMikdash,
of the building of the city and the tower
of the building of the Beis HaMikdash and Yerushalayim.
Chiel of Beis HaEli built Yericho
לֹא הָיָה חָרֵב בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ מֵעוֹלָם.
the Beis HaMikdash would never have been destroyed.
made by the twelve tribes in a circle,
the head of the tribes, was joined
which was the rear guard of all the camps.
This is the power of the aspect of circles,
which have no beginning and end,
over the aspect of the straight line;
and from this is made a surrounding light
that subdues the external forces and the kelipos.
through the mitzvah of sukkah and the encirclings with the lulav
to subdue the external forces to holiness
by means of the surrounding light.
for the sin of Adam HaRishon,
“He made for Adam and his wife
garments of skin and clothed them” —
the surrounding light of the garment.
וְהִנֵּה אָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (סוּכָּה מה, א)
Now our Sages of blessed memory said (Sukkah 45a)
with which they would surround the altar
that they were eleven amos tall.
It may be said that this has one intent
with the eleven spices of the ketores:
whose root is in the numbers eleven and nine,
and not nine and not eleven.
Among the spices of the ketores
there were ten kinds whose fragrance was good,
and the chelbenah was the eleventh,
to allude to the sinners of Israel,
who are included together in holiness.
It may be said that this too is
the allusion of our Sages of blessed memory
so that they would bend over a cubit
corresponding to the allusion of the chelbenah,
which is included among the spices,
Now the Rambam of blessed memory gives
of the flesh of the offerings;
and everyone cried out against it.
וְיֵשׁ לוֹמַר שֶׁהוּא גַּם כֵּן טַעַם אֶחָד
It may be said that it is in truth one reason
with the reason according to Kabbalah:
of the limbs and fats, as is known;
only that he, of blessed memory,
clothed the reason in a simple garment.
וְהִנֵּה בְּמַסֶּכֶת (תָּמִיד פֶּרֶק ג מִשְׁנָה ח)
and one of them was the fragrance,
for they would smell the fragrance of the ketores.
It may be said that this too
and it is the surrounding light
that subdues the kelipos, as mentioned above.
